validity_period.asked: how long should these readings be trusted before re-measuring

trapping_laser_rows.status: ENTERED 2026-09-24 on the person's two rulings below.
trapping_laser_rows.readings: Power sheet rows 128-135, OT 1064 nm, mirror in, multiband in, IR in: at 20x 0 / 64 / 126 / 380 / 633 mW at 0 / 5 / 10 / 30 / 50 %, and 1020 mW at 80 %; at 4x 890 mW and at 10x 1050 mW, both at 20 %.

head.asked: which head measured the trapping laser

trapping_laser_rows.head_range: Thorlabs' product page for the S121C, read 2026-09-24 in a browser: 'Standard Photodiode Power Sensor, Si, 400 - 1100 nm, 500 nW - 500 mW'. So 1064 nm is inside its wavelength range and 633, 1020, 890 and 1050 mW are ABOVE its power range. A photodiode above range typically reads low, not high, but out of range is out of its specification either way.
trapping_laser_rows.inconsistent_rows: At 20x the output rises steadily with level (64, 126, 380 mW at 5, 10, 30 %), which puts 20 % near 250 mW; the 4x and 10x rows give 890 and 1050 mW at 20 %. Either their level column is wrong or they were taken in a different state. Put to the person.
trapping_laser_rows.within_range: The 20x readings at 5, 10 and 30 % (64, 126, 380 mW) are inside the head's range.

ruling_enter_all.asked: enter only the in-range 20x readings and flag the rest, or re-measure with a head rated above 1 W?
ruling_enter_all.read_as: neither: enter all of them. Readings above the head's 500 mW range are entered flagged, at order-of-magnitude precision, since the purpose is a rough magnitude.

ruling_levels.asked: were the 4x and 10x rows really taken at 20 %?
ruling_levels.answer: if it seems switched, pls replace them properly
ruling_levels.why: the correction this seat inferred and the person's answer authorised. In every other block of the worksheet the 'objective' rows are taken at that block's REFERENCE level (100 %); this block's reference is 80 % (row 133), and 890 and 1050 mW sit beside the 20x 1020 mW at 80 % where a 20 % reading, by the 20x sweep, would be near 250 mW. The worksheet file is not edited; the correction lives here and in the entries.
